formal_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (y : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ) (L : Submodule ℂ (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → ∀ t : Fin k → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ), (∀ j, t j ∈ L) → ∑ a : Fin k → Fin m × Fin m, MvPolynomial.eval y ((List.ofFn a).foldr (fun i q => MvPolynomial.pderiv i q) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m)) * ∏ j, t j (a j) = 0
plain_statement: If perm_m(y + t) = 0 for every t in a linear space L, then for every k and t_1..t_k in L the k-th differential of perm_m at y applied to (t_1, .., t_k) is 0. The directional derivative along a vector of L of a polynomial vanishing on y + L vanishes on y + L; iterate k times. General form of L-gct-051, requested by seat-gct-1 for the cubic and quartic steps of L-gct-036.
title: Every polarized Taylor coefficient of perm at y vanishes on a linear space through y inside the hypersurface
